answers.brief_reasoning: dB/dt(0) = 0.05(30000) - 1200 = 1500 - 1200 = 300. The equilibrium balance is B = 1200/0.05 = 24000. Since 30000 > 24000, dB/dt stays positive, so the balance keeps growing.
answers.final_answer: dB/dt = 300 dollars per year at t=0, so the balance is increasing. The payment rate is not large enough: interest at t=0 is 1500 dollars per year, which is more than 1200. Because B stays above 24000, dB/dt stays positive and the loan is never paid off.

answers.brief_reasoning: Rewrite as dB/dt = 0.05(B - 24000). Separate: dB/(B - 24000) = 0.05 dt. Integrate: ln|B - 24000| = 0.05t + C, so B - 24000 = Ke^{0.05t}. At t=0, B = 30000 gives K = 6000.

A constant balance means dB/dt = 0. Then 0 = 0.05(30000) - P, so P = 1500. In part (b), the payment of 1200 is less than the 1500 of interest, so the balance grows exponentially instead of staying constant.
answers.final_answer: P = 1500 dollars per year. With this rate, B = 30000 is an equilibrium solution. In part (b), the payment of 1200 per year is less than the interest of 1500 per year, so B grows without bound and is not constant.
